Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
No, we can’t add an item to an order once it’s placed. If it hasn’t shipped, we may be able to cancel it so you can place a new order with both items, but cancellation isn’t guaranteed. Please request a cancellation as soon as possible and select “Cancel/Change Order.”
